rows.text: The Company now expects full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to be approximately $720 million, inclusive of full year contributions from the Micromax and EFC acquisitions and assuming stable exchange rates and metal prices, and an adjusted EPS growth rate of over 20% for the full year.

The Company now expects full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $690 million to $710 million, inclusive of expected contributions from the Micromax and EFC acquisitions on a full-year basis and assuming stable exchange rates and metal prices, and an adjusted EPS growth rate of approximately 20%.
